header: Today's headlines, live: the Business tab first (The Economic Times, Mint, The Hindu BusinessLine, The Wall Street Journal), then English, Hindi and Bengali, from the publishers' own free feeds. I made it keep itself current: every minute it asks again, quietly (nothing is replaced by a loading box), and the new stories slide in at the top of a list that does not jump (LiveStories.tsx). Checking pauses while the page is hidden and can be paused by hand (LiveStrip.tsx). Headlines and links only; each story opens on the publisher's page in a new tab; the feeds that did not answer are named. Nothing typed is sent anywhere (the request carries only the tab).

symbols.name: NEWS_REFRESH_MS
doc: How often the open tab asks again: the route keeps one answer for a minute, so a faster pace would only ask for the same answer.
